device.install: adb install -r with unchanged local debug signature (user data preserved)

endpoint.side_effects: Config row insert on first call only; no download, no parse, no activation

security_receipts.message: Browser or forwarded requests are not allowed

security_receipts.note: only method, path and bodyLength metadata emitted

identity.concurrent_create_guard: process-local critical section around find+create; unit test 8 threads -> 1 row, 1 cid

representative_normal_source.note: vod_id came from the returned list; no guessed ids. 配置 was excluded as menu data; 金牌影视 first category returned 0 items.

limitations: Rows 32/33/34 are non-active spike artifacts; their loopback source URLs are offline after cleanup and the feature is not PC-product-ready.
Import is loopback/ADB-only and relies on a non-simple header plus absent browser Origin; this is not cryptographic pairing and other local apps are inside the trusted device boundary.
Verification covers the non-active main-app catalog path only: no account/worker isolation, no execution of all 78 CSP sources.
POST body must be application/x-www-form-urlencoded; JSON bodies are out of scope.
Process-local serialization does not coordinate the separate origin worker process.
